subject: Realtime routing errors impacting NovaCorp — bridge & exec update
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -0000
Subject: Realtime routing errors impacting NovaCorp — bridge & exec update

Team —

We have an ongoing routing error that is returning 503s for a subset of NovaCorp traffic starting ~07:52 UTC. Impact: ~25% of requests are failing with our realtime routing service (model-router) for NovaCorp tenant. Symptoms look like a cache-miss -> downstream model shard failure.

Immediate asks:
- Marcus: start bridge (I created INC-7834) and capture logs.
- Ben: activate fallback routing to the quantized cached model variant for NovaCorp only.
- Evelyn: notify CS lead at NovaCorp and prepare an executive-facing update.
- Stephanie: capture prometheus spans and key traces for 07:45–08:10 UTC.

Short notes: we may need to route to Dedicated pool or enable forced-cache for affected routes while we diagnose. Attaching a short log snippet from the bridge.

Attachments: bridge_log_snippet.txt

—
Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

-----

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 08:12:13 -0000
Subject: Re: Realtime routing errors impacting NovaCorp — bridge & exec update

On it. Bridge (Zoom) up: zoom.us/j/123456789 at 08:14 UTC. Initial triage: model-router reports increased connection resets to model-worker-7 on GCP-eu-west. I’ll push a temporary route to cached-quantized-v2 for all NovaCorp requests (config diff attached).

Ben, please confirm the route flip and watch for error reduction. If errors fall <3% we can consider rolling back other mitigations.

Attachments: cached_routes_config.diff

—
Marcus Lin
SRE Lead, Serving Runtime
marcus@redwood.ai

-----

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@novacorp.com>, ops-team@novacorp.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:20:05 -0000
Subject: NovaCorp — interim executive update (service impact at 07:52 UTC)

Jane / NovaCorp Ops —

Quick executive summary from Redwood Inference: at 07:52 UTC today we began seeing elevated 503 errors for a subset of NovaCorp’s realtime inference traffic. Our engineering team detected the anomaly at 07:55 UTC and activated an incident bridge immediately.

What we know now:
- Scope: ~25% of NovaCorp realtime requests experienced 503s for roughly 40 minutes. Peak error window: 07:52–08:32 UTC.
- Root-candidate: model-router connections to a single model-worker shard (model-worker-7) started failing due to a transient network socket exhaustion on the worker host.
- Mitigation applied: at 08:14 UTC we temporarily routed NovaCorp traffic to a cached, quantized model variant (cached-quantized-v2) and enabled request-level retries. Error rate dropped from ~25% to <2% within 6 minutes.
- User impact: increased latency for cached responses (~+120ms P50) and degraded freshness for a small subset of predictions; we do not believe any persistent data loss occurred.

Actions underway and next steps:
1) Full diagnostic: we are collecting worker logs, kernel sockets, and system metrics for the affected host (owner: Marcus). Target ETA for full RCA draft: 2027-04-02 18:00 UTC.
2) Permanent remediation: if RCA confirms socket exhaustion, we will (a) harden worker pool socket limits, (b) roll out a small routing safeguard to avoid single-worker concentration, and (c) add an early-detection alert. Target ETA for remediation rollout: 2027-04-07.
3) Customer-facing follow-up: Redwood will provide a detailed postmortem and draft of proposed credits/SLR reconciliation by 2027-04-03.

We appreciate your patience; I am the primary point of contact for this incident. If NovaCorp leadership wants a short sync, I can join with Marcus/Ben.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

-----

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@novacorp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops-team@novacorp.com, cfo@novacorp.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:40:21 -0000
Subject: Re: NovaCorp — interim executive update (service impact at 07:52 UTC)

Naomi —

Thanks for the fast update and the mitigation. A few items from our side:
- Can you confirm whether any requests returned malformed payloads or partial predictions? We saw only 503s but want confirmation.
- We’ll want SLA credit details and a short timeline for when the postmortem will be shared with our security/compliance team.
- Could you please schedule a 30-min exec sync today or tomorrow (our CTO and CFO are on standby).

Appreciate the clarity and the routing fix so far.

—
Jane Doe
VP Product Operations, NovaCorp
jane.doe@novacorp.com

-----

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0000
Subject: Re: NovaCorp — interim executive update (service impact at 07:52 UTC)

Thanks, team. Quick internal follow-up to capture action owners: 
- Marcus: RCA draft (INC-7834) due 2027-04-02 18:00 UTC. Include kernel/socket metrics and worker host remediation steps.
- Ben: prepare proposed SLA credit calculation and two options (automatic pro-rata credit vs. one-time goodwill credit). Due 2027-04-03 12:00 UTC.
- Evelyn: schedule exec sync with NovaCorp (propose 2027-04-02 16:00 UTC or 2027-04-03 10:00 UTC). Confirm availability with Jane.
- Stephanie: collate traces and attach to the postmortem draft; check for any user-visible malformed payloads (due 2027-04-02 12:00 UTC).

I will draft the customer-facing postmortem outline and share a first pass by EOD Friday. We should also prepare a short internal blameless timeline and a remediation ticket for the worker pool allocations.

Attachments to include in postmortem: bridge_log_snippet.txt, cached_routes_config.diff

—
Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai
